class Stage0:
    """Pipeline stage 0."""
    def __init__(self, name='stage0'):
        self.name = name
        self.count = 0

    def run_stage_0(self, payload):
        self.count += 1
        data = json.loads(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
        data['stage'] = 0
        return data
